# Voteview fixtures

Recorded on 2026-10-24 from https://voteview.com/static/data/out/ (no key needed), then trimmed:

- `S119_rollcalls.csv` and `S119_votes.csv`: session-1 roll calls 15, 372, 614, 616, 617, 654 and 659, and session-2 roll call 1.
  Rolls 15, 372, 616, 617 and 659 are the same votes as the senate.gov fixtures in `../senate/`, so the two sources can be compared.
- `S119_members.csv`: unchanged.

Rows are exactly as published; only rows were removed.

Voteview: Lewis, Jeffrey B., Keith Poole, Howard Rosenthal, Adam Boche, Aaron Rudkin, and Luke Sonnet. Voteview: Congressional Roll-Call Votes Database. https://voteview.com/
